content: This document lists the prophecies of Zekaryah (Zechariah) concerning Yerushalem (Jerusalem), and tells about the hoped-for Messiah and the final judgement. It consists of two parts:
, Zekaryah’s prophecy concerning his revelation about saving Yerushalem, the replacement of the temple and its cleaning so that Yahweh’s people become holy, and
, the prophecies concerning the hoped-for Messiah and the final judgement.
It’s believed that this document was written between 520 and 518 before Yeshua/Jesus (B.C.)
